claims.text: The FDA adalimumab label identifies concomitant immunosuppressants, including corticosteroids, as a possible infection risk factor. Ciclesonide belongs to the corticosteroid class.
claims.quote: Patients 65 years of age and older, patients with co-morbid conditions and/or patients taking concomitant immunosuppressants (such as corticosteroids or methotrexate), may be at greater risk of infection.

headline.text: The FDA adalimumab label flags infection risk with concomitant immunosuppressants, including corticosteroids.

reported.text: This is a corticosteroid-class statement; it does not quantify risk for ciclesonide specifically.

gaps.text: No ciclesonide-specific combination study appears in the packet.
